_layers.name: Ashen Verge
_layers.tip:
Layer 1 · The Ashen Verge
Just past the Maw. Dead woods that still burn, old copper workings, and ash falling like snow.

_layers.name: Weeping Fens
_layers.tip:
Layer 2 · The Weeping Fens
Black water, red marsh, and trees that weep sap like blood. Hounds hunt here.

_layers.name: Brimstone Reach
_layers.tip:
Layer 3 · The Brimstone Reach
Burning slopes, a lake as still as glass, and moors that never stop smouldering.

_layers.name: Frozen Lament
_layers.tip:
Layer 4 · The Frozen Lament
Ice that holds the screaming, a shore that weeps salt, and pitbears on the ridges.

_layers.name: The Abyss
_layers.tip:
Layer 5 · The Abyss
Black water at the bottom of everything. The Throne Below waits here.
